phase_name: Typed Authority Model Production Consumer Conformance Re-Verification
summary: Independent implementation-conformance re-verification of pcae authority inspect against all 182 TAMPC-001 v1.1 requirements, treating no prior phase's own claims as an oracle. Confirmed via git log that neither production module (authority_inspection.py, authority_inspect.py) has changed since Phase 137K. Independently re-derived and cross-checked the requirement count (colon-anchored: 182 unique, 1-182, no gaps/duplicates). Live inspect.signature() confirmed the frozen three-parameter form. Directly reproduced TAMPC-REQ-179-182 with fresh live calls: a nonexistent path with valid artifact_bytes still inspects successfully (proves zero filesystem I/O on path), and json_output=True vs False produce byte-identical to_dict()/__eq__ results. Independently rebuilt the full packaging matrix (wheel, sdist, editable install), each exercised from a process outside the repository checkout, confirming byte-identical --json output across all four modes (checkout, wheel, editable, sdist), including a deliberately-mismatched artifact correctly producing exit code 1 / family_identity_mismatch. Re-ran tests/test_authority_inspect_137k.py + tests/test_typed_authority_inspector_137e.py (100/100), Fast Green (4391/4391, unchanged), a broader -k authority sweep (16 failed/3568 passed/3 skipped, identical to 137MV's own baseline, all sixteen individually re-confirmed unrelated), and a full untargeted suite (38 failed/25386 passed/10 skipped, all 38 independently confirmed pre-existing on unmodified main via git stash, unrelated to this consumer). All 182 requirements independently classified Satisfied; none Partially Satisfied, Violated, or Not Applicable. Two Non-Blocking findings persist unchanged from prior phases: TAMPC-REQ-078's literal dual-immutability-mechanism text remains unsatisfiable under this contract's own Python 3.9 dataclasses pin (first found by 137L), and 137MV's own F-3/F-4/F-5 editorial/pre-existing observations remain open and unrelated. No implementation, test, CLI-surface, or runtime change made.
tests_added_or_updated: None -- verification-only phase, no new test authored. Re-ran tests/test_authority_inspect_137k.py + tests/test_typed_authority_inspector_137e.py (100/100 passed), Fast Green (4391 passed), -k authority broader sweep (16 failed/3568 passed/3 skipped, all pre-existing/unrelated), and full untargeted suite (38 failed/25386 passed/10 skipped, all pre-existing/unrelated, independently confirmed against unmodified main via git stash).
